contract: {"interface":{"mode":"functional","class_name":null,"function_name":"solve","signature":"solve(s: str) -> int"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"isinstance(s, str)","description":"The input must be a string."},{"id":"P2","expression":"all(c.isalnum() for c in s)","description":"The string must contain only alphanumeric characters."},{"id":"P3","expression":"any(c.isdigit() for c in s)","description":"The string must contain at least one digit."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == max(int(num) for num in re.findall(r'\d+', s))","description":"The output must be the largest number found in the string."}],"invariants":[]}
